findings.active_kernel: Packed PTQ1_0 digits are decoded in registers and fed directly to DP4A; isum implements signed digit-1.
findings.int8_mma: m16n8k16 requires expanded/staged signed-byte weights and computes 8 output columns for batch-1 GEMV, yielding 8x aggregate products versus useful products.
findings.bit_sliced: Arbitrary signed-int8 activations do not permit replacing the weighted sum with simple popcount; mask extraction still needs base-3 decode.
